etymologies.etymologyHTML: Plural of custom. Perhaps influenced by or taken as a corruption of customhouse, from Middle English custome hous.

definitions.definition: (in the plural) The duties or taxes imposed on imported or exported goods.
(in the singular or uncountable) The government department or agency that is authorised to collect the taxes imposed on imported goods.
The process of going through customs checks at a border checkpoint.
The location at a border checkpoint where customs checks are carried out.

quote.citation: 2022, Jeph Jacques, Questionable Content (webcomic), 4922: Welcome To Canada:
quote.text: "You said someone from Cubetown was gonna meet us here at the airport?"  "Yeah.  We go through customs, then they'll meet us outside baggage claim."
